allowedSourceMaterial.overview: Two carefree pals traveling through rural Alabama on their way back to college are mistakenly arrested and charged with murder. Fortunately, one of them has a cousin who's a lawyer - Vincent Gambini, a former auto mechanic from Brooklyn who has just passed his bar exam after his sixth try. When he arrives with his leather-clad girlfriend to try his first case, it's a real shock - for him and the Deep South!

facts.overview: Two carefree pals traveling through rural Alabama on their way back to college are mistakenly arrested and charged with murder. facts.title: My Cousin Vinny

visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: Vincent barely passed the bar after six attempts and has never tried a case, leaving his innocent kin in the hands of sheer instinct.
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Wrongfully arrested for murder in rural Alabama, two college pals call in their only legal hope: Brooklyn cousin Vincent Gambini, a newly minted lawyer arriving with his sharp girlfriend to take on his very first trial.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: A funny, medium-paced legal comedy blending Southern courtroom procedure with lively cultural friction and moderate dramatic stakes.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Jonathan Lynn's comedy balances real courtroom stakes with irresistible culture-clash humor, turning a novice defense into an engaging clash of Southern order and Brooklyn swagger.
